onboarding.title: LTO Theory
onboarding.body: Questions stay in the original English from the reviewer. Pick your language and a question mark next to each line will show the translation.
onboarding.englishNote: English is the original text, so translations stay hidden.

home.learnBody: Go through every question in order. Pick an answer, then see whether it is right.
home.examBody: 40 random questions. You only see right or wrong after you answer.
home.signsBody: Learn the signs from the reviewer by category, then read what each one means.
home.mistakesBody: Answer the questions you got wrong while studying.

signs.intro: The signs are grouped the way the reviewer presents them. Open a category, then read each sign. The question mark shows the translation.

result.passHint: A non-professional exam passes at {{need}} of {{total}}.

settings.systemHint: System follows the device light or dark mode.
settings.languageHint: Translations appear next to the English text. English hides them.
settings.feedbackHint: Share ideas, wishes, or issues with the developer.

feedback.title: Feedback and suggestions
feedback.body: If you have ideas, wishes, or noticed something that can be improved in {{appName}}, please write to the support email below.
feedback.note: Thank you for helping make the app better.
